description.en-US: Declared here rather than inherited from core.basemodel.base_model, because that mixin carries the tenant key. Attempts are written by a background worker with no tenant in scope, so a tenant column would make every claim panic on a missing tenant id.
When this attempt row was created. Declared here because the auditable mixin also records who acted, and a scheduler worker acts as nobody.
1 for the first run. Unique per execution, which is the last line of defence against the same attempt being started twice.
'abandoned' means the lease expired without the attempt reporting an outcome, usually because the instance running it died.
Application instance that claimed this attempt.
How long the attempt ran. Bounded at 30 days, far above any attempt timeout, so the column cannot record a nonsensical duration.
When the following attempt may run, if one was permitted.
When this attempt's claim lapses. Past this point another instance may mark it abandoned and apply the retry policy.
Machine-readable failure reason, such as HTTP_503, TIMEOUT or COMMAND_ERROR.
Sanitized error detail. Must not carry credentials or full URLs with query strings.
Response status for a REST action.
